description: Grant a persona access to visit a community lot. Mayor-only. Updates the sidecar-local community-access.json file. The visit-lot handler checks this file before allowing a cross-lot transition to a community lot — without a grant, community lot visits return CLOSED for non-mayor avatars.

args.name: lot_id
args.description: The lot_id of the community lot to grant access to. Must exist in fso_lots with category='community'.

args.name: persona_name
args.description: The FSO_USER persona name (e.g. 'botrous', 'ellis') to grant access. Case-insensitive. Use '*' to grant access to all personas (open community lot).

call_signatures: cf $CF grant-community-access --lot_id 17 --persona_name botrous     # grant botrous access to lot 17
cf $CF grant-community-access --lot_id 17 --persona_name '*'         # open lot 17 to all personas
common_mistakes: Only the mayor can grant community access — non-mayor gets NO_AUTH.
persona_name must match FSO_USER exactly (case-insensitive) — it is NOT the avatar display name.
The grant persists in community-access.json across sidecar restarts.
Use persona_name='*' to allow any persona to visit (public community lot).
refuse_conditions: Caller is not the mayor → NO_AUTH
perception_hints: To check your lot_id: perception.lot.lot_id when on the community lot, or use query-lot
